input_hash_policy: Exact source byte SHA and canonical JSON SHA are recorded. Loader permits only CRLF/LF newline conversion and requires the recorded LF-normalized byte SHA plus identical canonical JSON SHA.
scope: Canonical physical inputs and historical evidence inventory; this manifest does not claim new numerical solves or G1R19 production completion.
policy_notes: N cases retain the existing Davis equivalent associated model with hold_initial; no nonassociated continuum-bound claim.
E and nu are catalog diagnostics and are not inputs of this rigid-plastic model.
D08A alone is coupled: fixed u=9.81*max(3-y,0), suction off, reference body b-grad(u_P1), no extra exposed-surface water traction.
All native initial fixed/reference loads are combined as reference_total for the Fs problem.
Historical whole-Excel time, historical Python root-stage time, new Python time and G1R19 cold-start reproduction are separate categories.

fresh_Python26_reference.scope: Reuse the existing accuracy_20261013 numerical implementation in a separate driver with explicit budgets and all26 input reconstruction; no historical fields or roots counted as cold runs.
fresh_Python26_reference.initial_mesh: Per-case initial_mesh entries; D08A P02A geometry alias with D08A materials/boundary/exact declared water body rebuilt.
fresh_Python26_reference.cold_profile_differs_from_official_Excel: Python refinement/root order, coarse mesh and budgets differ from Excel TARGET1000 LEGACY traversal; measure reachability, not identical production runtime.
fresh_Python26_reference.cold_profile_differs_from_old_native26: Old TARGET1536/CYCLES3/GAP1% versus Python per-case coarse meshes/CYCLES8/cap32000/GAP2%; same declared physical inputs and unchanged raw gates.
fresh_Python26_reference.time_label: New Python case elapsed and solver-stage times, separately measured from whole Excel and saved-field replay times
